name: Fritzgerald Aiden Leverton
source:
"My job as a knight is to protect my charge. To put their life before mine. If I can't protect you, how could I call myself a knight?"

Personal knight and guardian of the Crown Princess Lucette. Fritz is one of the best knights of the Order of Caldira and is loyal, selfless and supportive.

Appears to have the Fairytale Curse as well, though the nature of it is unknown, even to him.
